records.literal_gloss: And said Elijah the Tishbite, from [the] settlers of Gilead, to Ahab, [As] lives Yahweh, God of Israel, whom I stand before his face, if there will be [in] the years these dew and rain, except at [the] mouth of my word.

en.L: And Elijah the Tishbite, from the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, "[As] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there will be no dew or rain these years, except at my word."
en.B: Elijah the Tishbite, one of the settlers in Gilead, said to Ahab, "As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, lives, whom I serve, there will be neither dew nor rain in the years ahead unless I give the word."
en.R: Elijah the Tishbite, who lived among the settlers in Gilead, went to King Ahab. He said, "I serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel. As surely as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lives, there will be no dew and no rain during the next few years until I say so."

decisions.choice: from the settlers of Gilead
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text, as its vowels read it, calls Elijah one of the settlers of Gilead: people who lived there as residents without belonging to an old family of the land. The same letters can be read as "from Tishbe of Gilead", and the ancient Greek translation reads them so. That reading fits the title "the Tishbite" just before, but no town called Tishbe in Gilead is known for certain. The Hebrew text as read is kept here.

decisions.choice: Elijah the Tishbite: a prophet from Gilead, east of the Jordan, sent to King Ahab
decisions.reason: Elijah appears here with no account of his family or his call. "Tishbite" names the place or group he came from, whose location is now unknown. His name means "my God is Yahweh", which suits his whole work against the worship of Baal. Ahab was the king of Israel who had built a temple for Baal in Samaria (16:29-33).

decisions.choice: as Yahweh lives, before whom I stand: a solemn oath, and a claim to serve Yahweh
decisions.reason: Swearing by the life of Yahweh is the strongest oath (1 Samuel 14:39; 20:3). To "stand before" someone is to serve him as an attendant stands ready before a king (10:8; 12:8). Elijah speaks as Yahweh's servant and messenger, not by his own authority.

decisions.choice: if there will be dew or rain: the form of an oath meaning there will be none
decisions.reason: In an oath, "if this happens" leaves a curse unspoken, so it means "this will not happen". "Except at the mouth of my word" means "unless I say so": the drought will end only when Elijah, speaking for Yahweh, announces it (18:1, 41).

decisions.choice: no dew or rain: a challenge to Baal, who was worshiped as the giver of rain
decisions.reason: In the dry summer the land depends on dew, and in winter on rain. Baal, whom Ahab now served (16:31-32), was believed to send both. Yahweh's word stops them, which shows who truly controls the rain (18:1, 38-45).

decisions.choice: whom I serve (Balanced); I serve (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "before whom I stand" means, as meaning decision m3 explains. Literal keeps the picture.

decisions.choice: King Ahab; went to
decisions.reason: Readable names Ahab's title and says that Elijah went to him, since the story begins suddenly. Readable also puts the oath after Elijah's statement that he serves the LORD, to keep its sentences short.

decisions.choice: "Elías el tisbita"
decisions.reason: The Kings and Chronicles terms table's form, also the published Spanish New Testament's "Elías".

decisions.choice: "Vive el SEÑOR" (L); "Tan cierto como que vive el SEÑOR" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The oath as the Samuel note sets for Spanish; recorded once for this block.

decisions.choice: "Élie le Tishbite"
decisions.reason: Élie as in the French New Testament and the terms note; "Tishbite" with sh, as the French spelling of names in these books.

decisions.choice: "Aussi vrai que le SEIGNEUR ... est vivant"
decisions.reason: The oath as the Samuel terms note words it, at every level, for the whole block.

decisions.choice: Kama BWANA aishivyo
decisions.reason: The oath "as the LORD lives" is "Kama BWANA aishivyo" at every level, as the Samuel note sets.

decisions.choice: ambaye ninamtumikia (Balanced); Mimi ninamtumikia (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "before whom I stand"; Balanced and Readable give its sense, to serve, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Ê-li người Thi-sê-be"
decisions.reason: Elijah keeps the New Testament form "Ê-li" (as the terms note); the oath "Thật như CHÚA hằng sống" is the Samuel note's wording.

decisions.choice: Elijah says "tôi" to the king and calls him "vua"
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for prophets speaking to kings; Ahab in turn calls Elijah "ông" (18:17).

decisions.choice: Elijah speaks to Ahab in 하오체 ("-오", "-소")
alternatives: 합쇼체, as other prophets to kings
decisions.reason: The terms note lets Elijah speak to Ahab without deference. 하오체 keeps him respectful of the king's office while standing as his equal before the LORD; Ahab answers in 해라체 (18:17). Held through this block.

decisions.choice: "주께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하다"
decisions.reason: The Samuel terms note's wording for the oath "As the LORD lives".

decisions.choice: the wadi Cherith: a narrow valley with a seasonal stream
decisions.reason: A wadi is a valley cut by water that flows in the rainy season and can dry up in the dry months, as this one does (verse 7). Its exact location is unknown.

decisions.choice: on the face of the Jordan: east of the Jordan
alternatives: near the Jordan, on either side
decisions.reason: The phrase means "facing" the Jordan. Since Elijah is told to turn east, it most likely places the wadi on the east side of the river, near his home region of Gilead (verse 1).

decisions.choice: hide yourself: keep out of Ahab's reach
decisions.reason: After his message to Ahab, Elijah is in danger. Ahab later searches every nation for him (18:10), and the queen kills Yahweh's prophets (18:4).

decisions.choice: the Wadi Cherith (Balanced); Cherith Creek (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps "Wadi" as part of the name, as with the Wadi Besor (1 Samuel 30:9). Readable names the stream, which is what Elijah drinks from.

decisions.choice: "el torrente de Querit" (L); "el arroyo de Querit" (B, R)
decisions.reason: A wadi is a valley with a stream that runs only in the rainy season; Spanish "torrente" keeps that sense at Literal and "arroyo" is the plain word at Balanced and Readable. Querit is the usual Spanish form of Cherith.

decisions.choice: "le torrent de Kerith" (L, B); "le ruisseau de Kerith" (R)
decisions.reason: French "torrent" is the usual word for a stream that flows only in the rainy season; Readable says "ruisseau", the plainer word.

decisions.choice: kijito cha Kerithi
decisions.reason: A wadi is a narrow valley whose stream flows only in the wet season; Swahili "kijito" (stream) is used at every level, since Elijah drinks from it.

decisions.choice: God to Elijah: "ngươi" (L), "con" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Genesis note and Samuel: God calls his servant "ngươi" at Literal and "con" at Balanced and Readable; Elijah praying says "con" and calls God "Ngài".

decisions.choice: "khe Kê-rít" (L, B); "suối Kê-rít" (R)
decisions.reason: A wadi is a valley with a stream that runs only part of the year; "khe" names it, Readable says "suối" as the English says "creek".

decisions.choice: "그릿 시내" (L, B), "그릿 개울" (R)
decisions.reason: The wadi is a valley with a stream that dries up (verse 7); "시내" keeps the stream, and Readable uses the plain "개울".

decisions.choice: the ravens
decisions.reason: The Hebrew vowels read "the ravens", and verse 6 shows birds bringing food morning and evening. The same letters with other vowels could be read as "the Arabs", or as people from a place called Arabah, and some have preferred that reading because it seems more natural. But the story presents a wonder, and the text as read is kept.

decisions.choice: ravens: unclean birds that eat carrion
decisions.reason: Ravens were among the birds Israel was not to eat (Leviticus 11:15). Yahweh uses these unlikely creatures to feed his servant, as he feeds even the ravens themselves (Job 38:41; Psalm 147:9).

decisions.choice: I have commanded: the order is already given
decisions.reason: The verb looks at the command as already settled. Yahweh has provided before Elijah arrives, as he will also do with the widow (verse 9). "Feed" is a word for keeping someone supplied with food.

decisions.choice: bring you food
decisions.reason: Balanced says what "feed" means here: the ravens do not feed Elijah by hand but bring him food (verse 6).

source.text: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ וַיַּ֖עַשׂ כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב֙ בְּנַ֣חַל כְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And he went and did according to [the] word of Yahweh; and he went and dwelt at [the] wadi of Cherith which [is] on [the] face of the Jordan.

en.L: So he went and did according to the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; he went and lived by the wadi Cherith, which [is] facing the Jordan.
en.B: So Elijah did as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had told him. He went and stayed by the Wadi Cherith, east of the Jordan.
en.R: So Elijah obeyed {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He went and lived by Cherith Creek, east of the Jordan River.

es.L: Y fue e hizo conforme a la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; fue y habitó junto al torrente de Querit, que [está] frente al Jordán.
es.B: Así que Elías hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había dicho. Fue y se quedó junto al arroyo de Querit, al este del Jordán.
es.R: Así que Elías obedeció {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Fue y vivió junto al arroyo de Querit, al este del río Jordán.

fr.L: Et il s’en alla et fit selon la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; il s’en alla et habita près du torrent de Kerith, qui [est] en face du Jourdain.
fr.B: Élie fit donc ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait dit. Il alla s’établir près du torrent de Kerith, à l’est du Jourdain.
fr.R: Élie a donc obéi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Il est allé vivre près du ruisseau de Kerith, à l’est du Jourdain.

sw.L: Basi akaenda akafanya sawasawa na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; akaenda akakaa karibu na kijito cha Kerithi, kilicho mbele ya Yordani.
sw.B: Basi Eliya akafanya kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwambia. Akaenda akakaa karibu na kijito cha Kerithi, mashariki ya Yordani.
sw.R: Basi Eliya akamtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Akaenda akaishi karibu na kijito cha Kerithi, upande wa mashariki wa mto Yordani.

vi.L: Vậy ông đi và làm theo lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; ông đi và ở bên khe Kê-rít, đối diện sông Giô-đanh.
vi.B: Vậy Ê-li làm theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Ông đi đến ở bên khe Kê-rít, phía đông sông Giô-đanh.
vi.R: Vậy Ê-li vâng lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Ông đến ở bên suối Kê-rít, phía đông sông Giô-đanh.

ko.L: 그래서 그가 가서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀대로 행했다. 그가 가서 요단 앞에 있는 그릿 시내 곁에 살았다.
ko.B: 엘리야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로 했다. 그는 가서 요단강 동쪽에 있는 그릿 시내 곁에 머물렀다.
ko.R: 그래서 엘리야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 순종했다. 그는 가서 요단강 동쪽에 있는 그릿 개울 가에서 살았다.

decisions.choice: he went and did according to the word of Yahweh: exact obedience
decisions.reason: The narrator repeats the words of the command (verse 3) to show that Elijah did just what he was told. The same pattern marks the widow's obedience to Elijah's word (verse 15).

decisions.choice: Elijah (for "he")
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Elijah. Readable says "obeyed" for "did according to the word".

source.text: וְהָעֹרְבִ֗ים מְבִיאִ֨ים ל֜וֹ לֶ֤חֶם וּבָשָׂר֙ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וְלֶ֥חֶם וּבָשָׂ֖ר בָּעָ֑רֶב וּמִן־הַנַּ֖חַל יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the ravens [were] bringing to him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and from the wadi he drank.

en.L: And the ravens were bringing him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening, and he drank from the wadi.
en.B: The ravens brought him bread and meat every morning and every evening, and he drank from the stream.
en.R: Every morning and every evening the ravens brought Elijah bread and meat. And he drank water from the stream.

es.L: Y los cuervos le traían pan y carne por la mañana, y pan y carne por la tarde, y bebía del torrente.
es.B: Los cuervos le traían pan y carne cada mañana y cada tarde, y bebía del arroyo.
es.R: Cada mañana y cada tarde, los cuervos le traían a Elías pan y carne. Y él bebía agua del arroyo.

fr.L: Et les corbeaux lui apportaient du pain et de la viande le matin, et du pain et de la viande le soir, et il buvait au torrent.
fr.B: Les corbeaux lui apportaient du pain et de la viande matin et soir, et il buvait de l’eau du torrent.
fr.R: Chaque matin et chaque soir, les corbeaux apportaient à Élie du pain et de la viande. Et il buvait l’eau du ruisseau.

sw.L: Kunguru wakawa wakimletea mkate na nyama asubuhi, na mkate na nyama jioni; naye akanywa kutoka kijitoni.
sw.B: Kunguru walimletea mkate na nyama kila asubuhi na kila jioni, naye akanywa maji ya kijito.
sw.R: Kila asubuhi na kila jioni kunguru walimletea Eliya mkate na nyama. Naye akanywa maji ya kijito.

vi.L: Những con quạ đem bánh và thịt đến cho ông vào buổi sáng, bánh và thịt vào buổi chiều, và ông uống nước khe.
vi.B: Mỗi sáng mỗi chiều, bầy quạ đem bánh và thịt đến cho ông, và ông uống nước suối.
vi.R: Mỗi buổi sáng và mỗi buổi chiều, bầy quạ đem bánh và thịt đến cho Ê-li. Còn nước thì ông uống ở suối.

ko.L: 그리고 까마귀들이 아침에 빵과 고기를, 저녁에 빵과 고기를 그에게 가져왔고, 그는 그 시냇물을 마셨다.
ko.B: 까마귀들이 아침마다 저녁마다 그에게 빵과 고기를 가져다주었고, 그는 그 시냇물을 마셨다.
ko.R: 아침마다 저녁마다 까마귀들이 엘리야에게 빵과 고기를 가져다주었다. 그리고 그는 개울물을 마셨다.

decisions.choice: were bringing: this happened day after day
decisions.reason: The verb describes something that went on regularly, not a single delivery.

decisions.choice: bread and meat, morning and evening: an echo of the manna and the quails
decisions.reason: In the wilderness Yahweh gave Israel meat in the evening and bread in the morning (Exodus 16:8, 12). Here Elijah, alone in a dry place, receives both twice a day. "Bread" can also mean food in general.

decisions.choice: every morning and every evening
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable combine the two repeated phrases, which says the same thing more naturally. Readable names Elijah for "him".

source.text: וַיְהִ֛י מִקֵּ֥ץ יָמִ֖ים וַיִּיבַ֣שׁ הַנָּ֑חַל כִּ֛י לֹֽא־הָיָ֥ה גֶ֖שֶׁם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And it was at [the] end of days, and dried up the wadi, because there had not been rain in the land.

en.L: And it happened at the end of days that the wadi dried up, because there was no rain in the land.
en.B: After a while the stream dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.
en.R: But after some time the stream dried up, because no rain had fallen anywhere in the land.

es.L: Y sucedió al cabo de [unos] días que se secó el torrente, porque no había lluvia en la tierra.
es.B: Después de un tiempo, el arroyo se secó, porque no había llovido en la tierra.
es.R: Pero después de un tiempo, el arroyo se secó, porque no había llovido en ninguna parte del país.

fr.L: Et il arriva au bout de [quelques] jours que le torrent fut à sec, car il n’y avait pas eu de pluie dans le pays.
fr.B: Au bout d’un certain temps, le torrent fut à sec, car il n’avait pas plu dans le pays.
fr.R: Mais après un certain temps, le ruisseau s’est asséché, parce qu’il n’avait plu nulle part dans le pays.

sw.L: Ikawa mwisho wa siku, kijito kikakauka, kwa sababu hapakuwa na mvua katika nchi.
sw.B: Baada ya muda kijito kikakauka, kwa sababu hapakuwa na mvua katika nchi.
sw.R: Lakini baada ya muda kijito kikakauka, kwa sababu mvua haikunyesha popote katika nchi.

vi.L: Xảy ra, sau một thời gian, khe cạn nước, vì trong xứ không có mưa.
vi.B: Một thời gian sau, suối cạn khô vì trong xứ không có mưa.
vi.R: Nhưng ít lâu sau, suối cạn khô vì khắp xứ không có một giọt mưa nào.

ko.L: 그리고 날들이 지난 뒤에 그 시내가 말랐다. 그 땅에 비가 내리지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 얼마 뒤에 그 시내가 말라 버렸다. 그 땅에 비가 내리지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그런데 얼마 뒤에 개울이 말라 버렸다. 온 땅에 비가 한 방울도 내리지 않았기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: at the end of days: after some time
decisions.reason: The phrase gives no exact length. "Days" can sometimes mean a year (1 Samuel 1:21; 27:7), so it may mean "after a year", but the text does not say.

decisions.choice: the wadi dried up: Elijah himself feels the drought he announced
decisions.reason: The prophet who spoke the word is not spared its effects. Yahweh provides for him, but step by step, and now sends him elsewhere.

decisions.choice: anywhere in the land
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the drought covered the whole land.

source.text: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֥יו לֵאמֹֽר׃

en.B: Then the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to Elijah:
en.R: Then a message from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to Elijah:

es.B: Entonces la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino a Elías:
es.R: Entonces un mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino a Elías:

fr.B: Alors la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fut adressée à Élie :
fr.R: Ensuite un message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est venu à Élie :

sw.B: Kisha neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likamjia Eliya:
sw.R: Kisha ujumbe kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ukamjia Eliya:

vi.L: Lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với ông rằng:
vi.B: Bấy giờ lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với Ê-li:
vi.R: Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban sứ điệp này cho Ê-li:

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 그에게 임하여 말씀하셨다.
ko.B: 그때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 엘리야에게 임했다.
ko.R: 그때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 엘리야에게 말씀하셨다.

decisions.choice: the word of Yahweh came to him
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

decisions.choice: Elijah (for "him"); a message (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

source.text: ק֣וּם לֵ֤ךְ צָרְפַ֨תָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְצִיד֔וֹן וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֖ שָׁ֑ם הִנֵּ֨ה צִוִּ֥יתִי שָׁ֛ם אִשָּׁ֥ה אַלְמָנָ֖ה לְכַלְכְּלֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Arise, go to Zarephath, which [belongs] to Sidon, and dwell there; look, I have commanded there a woman, a widow, to feed you.

en.L: "Arise, go to Zarephath, which [belongs] to Sidon, and live there. Look, I have commanded a widow woman there to feed you."
en.B: "Get up and go to Zarephath, a town of Sidon, and stay there. I have commanded a widow there to provide for you."
en.R: "Get up and go to the town of Zarephath in the land of Sidon. Stay there. I have told a widow there to give you food."

es.L: «Levántate, ve a Sarepta, que [pertenece] a Sidón, y habita allí. He aquí que he mandado allí a una mujer viuda que te sustente».
es.B: «Levántate y ve a Sarepta, ciudad de Sidón, y quédate allí. He mandado a una viuda de allí que te dé de comer».
es.R: «Levántate y ve a la ciudad de Sarepta, en la tierra de Sidón. Quédate allí. Le he dicho a una viuda de allí que te dé de comer».

fr.L: « Lève-toi, va à Sarepta, qui [appartient] à Sidon, et habite là. Voici, j’ai ordonné là-bas à une femme veuve de te nourrir. »
fr.B: « Lève-toi, va à Sarepta, une ville de Sidon, et restes-y. J’ai ordonné à une veuve de là-bas de pourvoir à tes besoins. »
fr.R: « Lève-toi et va dans la ville de Sarepta, au pays de Sidon. Restes-y. J’ai dit à une veuve de là-bas de te donner à manger. »

sw.L: "Inuka, uende Sarepta, ulio [mji] wa Sidoni, ukae huko. Tazama, nimemwamuru mwanamke mjane huko akulishe."
sw.B: "Inuka uende Sarepta, mji wa Sidoni, ukae huko. Nimemwamuru mjane mmoja huko akupe chakula."
sw.R: "Inuka uende katika mji wa Sarepta katika nchi ya Sidoni. Ukae huko. Nimemwambia mjane mmoja huko akupe chakula."

vi.L: "Hãy đứng dậy, đi đến Sa-rép-ta, thuộc Si-đôn, và ở tại đó. Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho một người đàn bà góa ở đó nuôi ngươi."
vi.B: "Hãy đứng dậy đi đến Sa-rép-ta, một thành của Si-đôn, và ở lại đó. Ta đã truyền cho một bà góa ở đó lo cho con."
vi.R: "Hãy đứng dậy đi đến thành Sa-rép-ta trong xứ Si-đôn. Hãy ở lại đó. Ta đã bảo một bà góa ở đó cho con ăn."

ko.L: "일어나 시돈에 속한 사렙다로 가서 거기에 살아라. 보아라, 내가 거기 있는 한 과부 여인에게 명령하여 너를 먹이게 했다."
ko.B: "일어나 시돈의 성읍 사렙다로 가서 거기에 머물러라. 내가 거기 있는 한 과부에게 명령하여 너를 먹여 살리게 했다."
ko.R: "일어나 시돈 땅에 있는 사렙다라는 성읍으로 가거라. 거기에 머물러라. 내가 거기 사는 한 과부에게 너에게 먹을 것을 주라고 일러두었다."

decisions.choice: Zarephath of Sidon: a town on the coast, in Jezebel's homeland
decisions.reason: Zarephath lay on the Mediterranean coast between Tyre and Sidon, outside Israel. Sidon was the land of Jezebel's father, the king who served Baal (16:31). Yahweh sends his prophet into the heart of Baal's own country.

decisions.choice: I have commanded a widow to feed you: Yahweh has arranged it
decisions.reason: The same words were used of the ravens (verse 4). The widow does not seem to know of any command when Elijah meets her (verse 12), so the sense is that Yahweh has already decided she will provide for him. A widow had no husband to support her and was among the poorest people in the land (Deuteronomy 10:18).

decisions.choice: a town of Sidon (Balanced); the town of Zarephath in the land of Sidon (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Which belongs to Sidon" means that Zarephath was under Sidon, the main city of the region. Readable adds "town" and "land" for readers who do not know the names.

decisions.choice: "Sarepta", "Sidón"
decisions.reason: The Kings and Chronicles terms table's forms, as the published Spanish Luke 4:26.

decisions.choice: "Sarepta"
decisions.reason: The form of the French New Testament (Luke 4:26) and the terms note.

decisions.choice: "Sa-rép-ta"
decisions.reason: The form of Luke 4:26, as the terms note.

source.text: וַיָּ֣קָם׀וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ צָרְפַ֗תָה וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־פֶּ֣תַח הָעִ֔יר וְהִנֵּֽה־שָׁ֛ם אִשָּׁ֥ה אַלְמָנָ֖ה מְקֹשֶׁ֣שֶׁת עֵצִ֑ים וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֵלֶ֨יהָ֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר קְחִי־נָ֨א לִ֧י מְעַט־מַ֛יִם בַּכְּלִ֖י וְאֶשְׁתֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he arose and went to Zarephath, and he came to [the] entrance of the city, and look, there a woman, a widow, [was] gathering sticks; and he called to her and said, Get, please, for me a little water in the vessel, and I may drink.

en.L: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And he came to the entrance of the city, and look, there a widow woman [was] gathering sticks. And he called to her and said, "Please get me a little water in a vessel, so that I may drink."
en.B: So he got up and went to Zarephath. When he came to the town gate, there was a widow gathering sticks. He called to her, "Please bring me a little water in a cup so I can drink."
en.R: So Elijah went to Zarephath. When he came to the town gate, he saw a widow there picking up sticks. He called out to her, "Please bring me a little water in a cup to drink."

es.L: Y se levantó y fue a Sarepta. Y llegó a la entrada de la ciudad, y he aquí que había allí una mujer viuda recogiendo leña. Y la llamó y le dijo: «Tráeme, por favor, un poco de agua en un vaso para que beba».
es.B: Así que se levantó y fue a Sarepta. Cuando llegó a la puerta de la ciudad, había allí una viuda recogiendo leña. Él la llamó y le dijo: «Por favor, tráeme un poco de agua en un vaso para beber».
es.R: Así que Elías fue a Sarepta. Cuando llegó a la puerta de la ciudad, vio allí a una viuda que estaba recogiendo leña. La llamó y le dijo: «Por favor, tráeme un poco de agua en un vaso para beber».

fr.L: Et il se leva et alla à Sarepta. Et il arriva à l’entrée de la ville, et voici, il y avait là une femme veuve qui ramassait du bois. Et il l’appela et dit : « Va me chercher, je te prie, un peu d’eau dans un récipient, pour que je boive. »
fr.B: Il se leva donc et alla à Sarepta. Quand il arriva à la porte de la ville, il y avait là une veuve qui ramassait du bois. Il l’appela : « Apporte-moi, je te prie, un peu d’eau dans une cruche pour que je boive. »
fr.R: Élie est donc allé à Sarepta. En arrivant à la porte de la ville, il a vu là une veuve qui ramassait du bois. Il l’a appelée : « S’il te plaît, apporte-moi un peu d’eau dans une cruche pour que je boive. »

sw.L: Basi akainuka akaenda Sarepta. Alipofika kwenye lango la mji, tazama, mwanamke mjane [alikuwa] huko akiokota kuni. Akamwita, akasema, "Tafadhali, niletee maji kidogo katika chombo, ninywe."
sw.B: Basi akainuka akaenda Sarepta. Alipofika kwenye lango la mji, mjane mmoja alikuwa huko akiokota kuni. Akamwita, "Tafadhali niletee maji kidogo katika kikombe ninywe."
sw.R: Basi Eliya akaenda Sarepta. Alipofika kwenye lango la mji, alimwona mjane mmoja akiokota vijiti. Akamwita, "Tafadhali niletee maji kidogo katika kikombe ninywe."

vi.L: Vậy ông đứng dậy đi đến Sa-rép-ta. Khi ông đến cổng thành, kìa, có một người đàn bà góa đang lượm củi ở đó. Ông gọi bà và nói: "Xin bà lấy cho tôi một chút nước trong bình để tôi uống."
vi.B: Vậy ông đứng dậy đi đến Sa-rép-ta. Khi đến cổng thành, ông thấy một bà góa đang lượm củi. Ông gọi bà: "Xin bà mang cho tôi một chút nước trong chén để tôi uống."
vi.R: Vậy Ê-li đi đến Sa-rép-ta. Khi đến cổng thành, ông thấy một bà góa đang nhặt củi ở đó. Ông gọi bà: "Xin bà mang cho tôi một chút nước trong chén để uống."

ko.L: 그래서 그가 일어나 사렙다로 갔다. 그가 성읍 입구에 이르렀을 때, 보라, 거기에 한 과부 여인이 나뭇가지를 줍고 있었다. 그가 그 여자를 불러 말했다. "부디 그릇에 물을 조금 가져다주어 내가 마시게 해 주시오."
ko.B: 엘리야는 일어나 사렙다로 갔다. 그가 성문에 이르렀을 때, 마침 한 과부가 거기서 나뭇가지를 줍고 있었다. 그가 그 여자를 불러 말했다. "마실 물을 그릇에 조금만 떠다 주시오."
ko.R: 그래서 엘리야는 사렙다로 갔다. 그가 성문에 이르렀을 때, 한 과부가 거기서 나뭇가지를 줍고 있는 것이 보였다. 그가 그 여자를 불러 말했다. "마실 물을 그릇에 조금만 가져다주시오."

decisions.choice: the entrance of the city: the town gate
decisions.reason: The gate was the busiest place in a town, where people met, traded and settled disputes. Elijah meets the widow as soon as he arrives.

decisions.choice: look, there a widow: the very woman Yahweh spoke of
decisions.reason: "Look" brings the reader into what Elijah saw: a widow, just as Yahweh had said (verse 9).

decisions.choice: gathering sticks; a little water: signs of poverty and drought
decisions.reason: She gathers sticks for a small fire, and water has become scarce. Asking a stranger for water was a normal request (Genesis 24:17), but in a drought it was a real gift. "Please" makes the request polite.

decisions.choice: cup
decisions.reason: The word means any container. Balanced and Readable say "cup", the kind of vessel someone would drink from.

decisions.choice: "une cruche" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word means any container; for water carried from a well French says "cruche". Literal keeps "récipient".

decisions.choice: Elijah and the widow: "bà" and "tôi"; she calls him "ông"
decisions.reason: Strangers speak to each other with the polite "ông", "bà" and "tôi", as the Genesis note sets for strangers and hosts.

decisions.choice: Elijah speaks to the widow in 하오체, and she answers in 합쇼체
alternatives: 합쇼체 both ways, as between strangers
decisions.reason: The prophet asks a favor of a poor stranger with courtesy but not deference; she, seeing a man of God (verse 18), speaks up to him.

en.R: As she was going, he called to her again, "Please bring me a piece of bread too."

es.B: Mientras ella iba a buscarla, él la llamó y le dijo: «Por favor, tráeme también un pedazo de pan».
es.R: Mientras ella iba, él la llamó otra vez y le dijo: «Por favor, tráeme también un pedazo de pan».

fr.B: Comme elle allait en chercher, il lui cria : « Apporte-moi aussi, je te prie, un morceau de pain. »
fr.R: Pendant qu’elle y allait, il l’a appelée de nouveau : « S’il te plaît, apporte-moi aussi un morceau de pain. »

sw.B: Alipokuwa akienda kuyaleta, akamwita, "Tafadhali uniletee pia kipande cha mkate."
sw.R: Alipokuwa akienda, akamwita tena, "Tafadhali niletee pia kipande cha mkate."

vi.B: Khi bà đang đi lấy nước, ông gọi theo: "Xin bà cũng mang cho tôi một miếng bánh nữa."
vi.R: Khi bà đang đi, ông gọi bà lần nữa: "Xin bà mang cho tôi một miếng bánh nữa."

ko.B: 그 여자가 물을 가지러 가자, 그가 그 여자를 불러 말했다. "빵도 한 조각 가져다주시오."
ko.R: 그 여자가 물을 가지러 가는데, 엘리야가 다시 불러 말했다. "빵도 한 조각 가져다주시오."

decisions.choice: in your hand: bring it with you
decisions.reason: Elijah asks her to bring the bread along with the water. He asks for only a piece, but in a famine even that is more than she can spare (verse 12).

decisions.choice: too
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "too" to show that this request is added to the first. Readable leaves "in your hand" unsaid, since "bring" already says it.

source.text: וַתֹּ֗אמֶר חַי־יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ אִם־יֶשׁ־לִ֣י מָע֔וֹג כִּ֣י אִם־מְלֹ֤א כַף־קֶ֨מַח֙ בַּכַּ֔ד וּמְעַט־שֶׁ֖מֶן בַּצַּפָּ֑חַת וְהִנְנִ֨י מְקֹשֶׁ֜שֶׁת שְׁנַ֣יִם עֵצִ֗ים וּבָ֨אתִי֙ וַעֲשִׂיתִ֨יהוּ֙ לִ֣י וְלִבְנִ֔י וַאֲכַלְנֻ֖הוּ וָמָֽתְנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And she said, [As] lives Yahweh your God, if there is to me a cake, except only [the] fullness of [a] palm of flour in the jar and a little oil in the jug; and look, I [am] gathering two sticks, and I will go in and make it for myself and for my son, and we will eat it and we will die.

en.L: And she said, "[As] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God lives, I have no cake, only a handful of flour in the jar and a little oil in the jug. And look, I [am] gathering two sticks, and I will go in and make it for myself and for my son, and we will eat it and die."
en.B: She said, "As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God lives, I have nothing baked, only a handful of flour in the jar and a little oil in the jug. I am gathering a couple of sticks so I can go home and prepare it for my son and me. We will eat it, and then we will die."
en.R: She answered, "As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God lives, I do not have any bread. All I have is a handful of flour in a jar and a little olive oil in a jug. I am picking up a few sticks to take home and make a last meal for my son and me. After we eat it, we will die."

es.L: Y ella dijo: «Vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, que no tengo pan cocido, sino solo un puñado de harina en la tinaja y un poco de aceite en la vasija. Y he aquí que estoy recogiendo dos leños, y entraré y lo prepararé para mí y para mi hijo, y lo comeremos y moriremos».
es.B: Ella respondió: «Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, no tengo nada cocido; solo tengo un puñado de harina en la tinaja y un poco de aceite en la vasija. Estoy recogiendo un par de leños para ir a casa y prepararlo para mi hijo y para mí. Lo comeremos, y después moriremos».
es.R: Ella le contestó: «Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios, no tengo pan. Solo me queda un puñado de harina en una tinaja y un poco de aceite de oliva en una vasija. Estoy recogiendo unos cuantos leños para llevarlos a casa y hacer una última comida para mi hijo y para mí. Después de comerla, moriremos».

fr.L: Et elle dit : « Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu est vivant, je n’ai pas de galette, seulement une poignée de farine dans la jarre et un peu d’huile dans la cruche. Et voici, je ramasse deux morceaux de bois, et je vais rentrer et la préparer pour moi et pour mon fils ; nous la mangerons, et nous mourrons. »
fr.B: Elle répondit : « Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu est vivant, je n’ai rien de cuit ; j’ai seulement une poignée de farine dans la jarre et un peu d’huile dans la cruche. Je ramasse deux ou trois morceaux de bois pour rentrer préparer cela pour mon fils et pour moi. Nous le mangerons, puis nous mourrons. »
fr.R: Elle a répondu : « Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu est vivant, je n’ai pas de pain. Tout ce que j’ai, c’est une poignée de farine dans une jarre et un peu d’huile d’olive dans une cruche. Je ramasse quelques morceaux de bois pour rentrer faire un dernier repas pour mon fils et moi. Quand nous l’aurons mangé, nous mourrons. »

sw.L: Akasema, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako aishivyo, sina mkate, ila konzi ya unga katika mtungi na mafuta kidogo katika chupa. Na tazama, mimi [ninaokota] vijiti viwili, nami nitaingia na kujiandalia mimi na mwanangu, ili tule, kisha tufe."
sw.B: Akajibu, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako aishivyo, sina chochote kilichookwa, ila konzi ya unga katika mtungi na mafuta kidogo katika chupa. Ninaokota vijiti viwili hivi ili niende nyumbani niupike kwa ajili yangu na mwanangu. Tutaula, kisha tutakufa."
sw.R: Akajibu, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako aishivyo, sina mkate wowote. Nina konzi moja tu ya unga katika mtungi na mafuta kidogo ya zeituni katika chupa. Ninaokota vijiti vichache ili niende nyumbani kupika mlo wa mwisho kwa ajili yangu na mwanangu. Tukishaula, tutakufa."

vi.L: Bà nói: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông hằng sống, tôi không có bánh nướng, chỉ có một nắm bột trong hũ và một chút dầu trong bình. Kìa, tôi đang lượm hai que củi, rồi tôi sẽ về làm bánh cho tôi và con trai tôi; chúng tôi sẽ ăn, rồi chết."
vi.B: Bà đáp: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông hằng sống, tôi không có sẵn bánh, chỉ còn một nắm bột trong hũ và một chút dầu trong bình. Tôi đang lượm vài que củi để về nấu cho mẹ con tôi. Chúng tôi sẽ ăn, rồi sẽ chết."
vi.R: Bà trả lời: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông hằng sống, tôi không có bánh. Tôi chỉ còn một nắm bột trong hũ và một chút dầu ô-liu trong bình. Tôi đang nhặt vài que củi để mang về nấu bữa ăn cuối cùng cho mẹ con tôi. Ăn xong, chúng tôi sẽ chết."

ko.L: 그러자 그 여자가 말했다. "당신의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세합니다. 저에게는 구운 것이 없고, 다만 항아리에 밀가루 한 줌과 병에 기름이 조금 있을 뿐입니다. 보십시오, 제가 나뭇가지 두어 개를 줍고 있습니다. 들어가서 저와 제 아들을 위해 그것으로 [음식을] 만들어 먹고, 그다음에는 죽을 것입니다."
ko.B: 그 여자가 대답했다. "당신의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하는데, 저에게는 구운 빵이 하나도 없습니다. 항아리에 밀가루 한 줌과 병에 기름 조금이 있을 뿐입니다. 저는 지금 나뭇가지 두어 개를 주워다가, 집에 가서 저와 제 아들을 위해 그것으로 음식을 만들려고 합니다. 그것을 먹고 나면 저희는 죽을 것입니다."
ko.R: 그 여자가 대답했다. "당신의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하는데, 저에게는 빵이 하나도 없습니다. 항아리에 밀가루 한 줌과 병에 올리브기름 조금이 있을 뿐입니다. 저는 나뭇가지 몇 개를 주워 집에 가서, 저와 제 아들이 먹을 마지막 음식을 만들려고 합니다. 그것을 먹고 나면 저희는 죽을 것입니다."

decisions.choice: as Yahweh your God lives: she swears by the God of Elijah
decisions.reason: She uses the same oath as Elijah (verse 1), but says "your God". She knows Elijah is an Israelite who worships Yahweh, and does not claim Yahweh as her own God. "If there is to me" is the form of an oath meaning "there is not" (see verse 1).

decisions.choice: cake: something baked
decisions.reason: The word is rare (Psalm 35:16) and means baked bread or a cake. She has flour, but nothing ready to eat.

decisions.choice: the jar and the jug: a storage jar for flour and a small jug for oil
decisions.reason: The first is a clay jar of the kind used to carry water or store grain (Genesis 24:14). The second is a small flask for oil, which was olive oil used in cooking.

decisions.choice: two sticks: a few sticks
decisions.reason: "Two" means only a small number, enough for one small fire.

decisions.choice: a last meal
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear what she means: this is the last of her food, and after it she expects to starve. Readable also says "olive oil".

decisions.choice: mtungi; chupa
decisions.reason: The flour is kept in a "mtungi" (storage jar) and the oil in a small "chupa" (flask), as the meaning decision describes.

decisions.choice: "Thật như CHÚA Đức Chúa Trời của ông hằng sống"
decisions.reason: The Samuel note's oath wording; the widow swears by Elijah's God, so "của ông" is kept at every level.

es.B: Elías le dijo: «No tengas miedo. Ve y haz lo que has dicho. Pero primero hazme un pan pequeño con lo que tienes y tráemelo. Después prepara algo para ti y para tu hijo.

fr.L: Et Élie lui dit : « Ne crains pas. Va, fais selon ta parole. Seulement, fais-m’en d’abord une petite galette, et apporte[-la]-moi dehors ; et ensuite tu en feras pour toi et pour ton fils.
