fr.R: Élie lui a dit : « N’aie pas peur. Rentre chez toi et fais ce que tu as dit. Mais d’abord, avec ce que tu as, fais-moi un petit pain et apporte-le-moi. Ensuite, tu en feras pour toi et pour ton fils.

sw.L: Eliya akamwambia, "Usiogope. Nenda, ufanye sawasawa na neno lako. Ila unifanyie kwanza mkate mdogo kutoka humo, uniletee nje, kisha ujifanyie wewe na mwanao baadaye.
sw.B: Eliya akamwambia, "Usiogope. Nenda ufanye kama ulivyosema. Lakini kwanza unioke mkate mdogo kutokana na ulicho nacho, uniletee hapa nje. Baada ya hapo, ujipikie wewe na mwanao.
sw.R: Eliya akamwambia, "Usiogope. Nenda nyumbani ufanye kama ulivyosema. Lakini kwanza unipikie mkate mdogo kutokana na ulicho nacho, uniletee. Baada ya hapo, ujipikie wewe na mwanao.

vi.L: Ê-li nói với bà: "Đừng sợ. Hãy đi làm như lời bà nói. Nhưng trước hết hãy làm cho tôi một cái bánh nhỏ từ chỗ bột đó và đem ra cho tôi, sau đó hãy làm cho bà và con trai bà.
vi.B: Ê-li nói với bà: "Bà đừng sợ. Hãy về làm như bà đã nói. Nhưng trước hết hãy làm cho tôi một cái bánh nhỏ từ chỗ bột ấy và đem ra cho tôi. Sau đó bà hãy làm cho bà và con trai bà.
vi.R: Ê-li nói với bà: "Bà đừng sợ. Hãy về nhà làm như bà đã nói. Nhưng trước hết hãy dùng chỗ bột ấy làm cho tôi một cái bánh nhỏ và đem đến cho tôi. Sau đó hãy làm bánh cho bà và con trai bà.

ko.L: 그러자 엘리야가 그 여자에게 말했다. "두려워하지 마시오. 가서 당신 말대로 하시오. 다만 먼저 그것으로 나를 위해 작은 빵 하나를 만들어 내게 가져오고, 그 뒤에 당신과 당신 아들을 위해 만드시오.
ko.B: 엘리야가 그 여자에게 말했다. "두려워하지 마시오. 가서 말한 대로 하시오. 그러나 먼저 그것으로 나에게 작은 빵 하나를 구워 가져오시오. 그다음에 당신과 당신 아들을 위해 만드시오.
ko.R: 엘리야가 그 여자에게 말했다. "두려워하지 마시오. 집에 가서 말한 대로 하시오. 그러나 먼저 가진 것으로 나에게 작은 빵 하나를 만들어 가져오시오. 그다음에 당신과 아들이 먹을 것을 만드시오.

decisions.choice: do not fear: reassurance before a promise
decisions.reason: "Do not fear" often comes just before Yahweh's promise of help (Genesis 15:1; 21:17). Elijah's reason follows in verse 14.

decisions.choice: a small cake: a round flat loaf
decisions.reason: The word names a flat round bread, baked on hot stones or coals (Genesis 18:6; 19:3).

decisions.choice: first ... afterward: Elijah asks her to feed him before herself
decisions.reason: The words "first" and "at last" frame the request. Elijah asks her to put the word of Yahweh to the test by giving away her last food first. "Bring it out" suggests that she bakes inside and brings it out to him.

decisions.choice: small loaf
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "loaf", since an English "cake" is usually sweet.

source.text: כִּ֣י כֹה֩ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּ֤ד הַקֶּ֨מַח֙ לֹ֣א תִכְלָ֔ה וְצַפַּ֥חַת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לֹ֣א תֶחְסָ֑ר עַ֠ד י֧וֹם תֵּת־יְהוָ֛ה גֶּ֖שֶׁם עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh, God of Israel, [The] jar of the flour not will be finished, and [the] jug of the oil not will be lacking, until [the] day [that] gives Yahweh rain on [the] face of the ground.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel: 'The jar of flour will not be used up, and the jug of oil will not run short, until the day [that] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gives rain on the face of the ground.'"
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, says this: 'The jar of flour will not be emptied, and the jug of oil will not give out, until the day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sends rain on the land.'"
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, says: 'Your jar of flour will not become empty, and your jug of oil will not run out, until the day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sends rain on the land again.'"

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel: “La tinaja de la harina no se acabará, ni la vasija del aceite faltará, hasta el día [en que] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dé lluvia sobre la faz de la tierra”».
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, dice esto: “La tinaja de harina no se vaciará, y la vasija de aceite no se agotará, hasta el día en que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envíe lluvia sobre la tierra”».
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel: “Tu tinaja de harina no se quedará vacía, y tu vasija de aceite no se acabará, hasta el día en que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vuelva a enviar lluvia sobre la tierra”».

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël : “La jarre de farine ne s’épuisera pas, et la cruche d’huile ne manquera pas, jusqu’au jour où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} donnera la pluie sur la face du sol.” »
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci : “La jarre de farine ne se videra pas, et la cruche d’huile ne s’épuisera pas, jusqu’au jour où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} enverra la pluie sur le pays.” »
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël : “Ta jarre de farine ne sera jamais vide, et ta cruche d’huile ne manquera jamais d’huile, jusqu’au jour où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} enverra de nouveau la pluie sur le pays.” »

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, asema hivi: 'Mtungi wa unga hautakwisha, wala chupa ya mafuta haitapungua, mpaka siku [ile] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakapoleta mvua juu ya uso wa nchi.'"
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo: 'Mtungi wa unga hautaisha, wala chupa ya mafuta haitakauka, mpaka siku {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakaponyesha mvua juu ya nchi.'"
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema: 'Mtungi wako wa unga hautakuwa mtupu, wala chupa yako ya mafuta haitaisha, mpaka siku {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakaponyesha mvua tena juu ya nchi.'"

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này: 'Hũ bột sẽ không cạn, và bình dầu sẽ không vơi, cho đến ngày {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban mưa xuống mặt đất.'"
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy: 'Hũ bột sẽ không cạn, bình dầu sẽ không vơi, cho đến ngày {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban mưa xuống đất.'"
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán: 'Hũ bột của bà sẽ không cạn, và bình dầu của bà sẽ không hết, cho đến ngày {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lại ban mưa xuống đất.'"

ko.L: 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하시기 때문이오. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 땅 위에 비를 내리시는 날까지, 밀가루 항아리가 비지 않고 기름병이 마르지 않을 것이다.'"
ko.B: 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하시기 때문이오. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 땅에 비를 내려 주시는 날까지, 밀가루 항아리가 비지 않고 기름병이 마르지 않을 것이다.'"
ko.R: 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이 이렇기 때문이오. '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다시 땅에 비를 내려 주시는 날까지, 네 밀가루 항아리는 비지 않고 네 기름병은 마르지 않을 것이다.'"

decisions.choice: thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel: a prophet's message formula
decisions.reason: A messenger began by naming who sent him. Elijah gives the widow a promise in Yahweh's own words. He calls Yahweh "the God of Israel" even in Sidon: Israel's God, not Baal, keeps a foreign widow alive.

decisions.choice: until the day Yahweh gives rain
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text has a different form of the verb "give" from the one read aloud in the tradition, but both mean the same.

decisions.choice: until Yahweh gives rain: the drought is in Yahweh's hands
decisions.reason: The promise looks ahead to the end of the drought (18:1, 45). The same God who stopped the rain will send it, and until then he will provide.

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD (Literal); the LORD says this (Balanced); This is what the LORD says (Readable)
decisions.reason: The message formula is worded the same way throughout Samuel and Kings. Yahweh's words inside Elijah's speech take single quotes. Readable adds "again" to make clear the rain will return, and says "your" jar and jug, since the promise is about the widow's own supplies.

source.text: וַתֵּ֥לֶךְ וַתַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה כִּדְבַ֣ר אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַתֹּ֧אכַל הִֽיא־וָה֛וּא וּבֵיתָ֖הּ יָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And she went and did according to [the] word of Elijah; and ate she and he and her household [many] days.

en.L: And she went and did according to the word of Elijah, and she and he and her household ate [for many] days.
en.B: She went and did as Elijah had said, and she and he and her household had food to eat for many days.
en.R: So she went and did what Elijah told her. And there was food every day for her and her family and for Elijah.

es.L: Y ella fue e hizo conforme a la palabra de Elías, y comieron ella y él y su casa [muchos] días.
es.B: Ella fue e hizo lo que Elías le había dicho, y ella, él y los de su casa tuvieron comida durante muchos días.
es.R: Así que ella fue e hizo lo que Elías le dijo. Y hubo comida todos los días para ella, para su familia y para Elías.

fr.L: Et elle s’en alla et fit selon la parole d’Élie ; et elle mangea, elle et lui et sa maison, [pendant des] jours.
fr.B: Elle alla faire ce qu’Élie avait dit, et elle eut de quoi manger pendant longtemps, elle, lui et sa famille.
fr.R: Elle est donc allée faire ce qu’Élie lui avait dit. Et chaque jour, il y a eu de quoi manger pour elle, pour sa famille et pour Élie.

sw.L: Akaenda akafanya sawasawa na neno la Eliya; naye akala, yeye na yeye na jamaa yake [kwa] siku [nyingi].
sw.B: Akaenda akafanya kama Eliya alivyosema, naye pamoja na Eliya na jamaa yake wakapata chakula kwa siku nyingi.
sw.R: Basi akaenda akafanya kama Eliya alivyomwambia. Kukawa na chakula kila siku kwa ajili yake, kwa ajili ya jamaa yake na kwa ajili ya Eliya.

vi.L: Bà đi và làm theo lời của Ê-li; bà, ông và cả nhà bà đều có ăn [nhiều] ngày.
vi.B: Bà đi và làm như Ê-li đã nói. Bà, ông và cả nhà bà đều có ăn trong nhiều ngày.
vi.R: Vậy bà đi và làm theo lời Ê-li. Ngày nào bà, gia đình bà và Ê-li cũng có thức ăn.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자가 가서 엘리야의 말대로 행했다. 그리고 그 여자와 그와 그 여자의 집안이 [여러] 날 동안 먹었다.
ko.B: 그 여자는 가서 엘리야가 말한 대로 했다. 그래서 그 여자와 엘리야와 그 여자의 집안 식구들이 여러 날 동안 먹을 것이 있었다.
ko.R: 그래서 그 여자는 가서 엘리야가 말한 대로 했다. 그러자 그 여자와 그 집 식구들과 엘리야가 날마다 먹을 것이 있었다.

decisions.choice: she and he
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text has "he and she"; the form read aloud in the tradition has "she and he". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: days: for a long time
decisions.reason: The bare word "days" means for many days, perhaps for a whole year (as in verse 7). The food lasted as long as it was needed.

decisions.choice: she went and did according to the word of Elijah: her obedience matches his
decisions.reason: The widow obeys Elijah's word just as Elijah obeyed Yahweh's (verse 5). "Her household" is her son and perhaps others living with her.

decisions.choice: had food to eat for many days (Balanced); there was food every day (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out what the bare word "days" means.

decisions.choice: yeye na yeye
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "she and he" is kept at Literal as "yeye na yeye", since Swahili "yeye" serves for both; Balanced and Readable name Elijah.

source.text: כַּ֤ד הַקֶּ֨מַח֙ לֹ֣א כָלָ֔תָה וְצַפַּ֥חַת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לֹ֣א חָסֵ֑ר כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר בְּיַ֥ד אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: [The] jar of the flour not was finished, and [the] jug of the oil not was lacking, according to [the] word of Yahweh which he spoke by [the] hand of Elijah.

en.L: The jar of flour was not used up, and the jug of oil did not run short, according to the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke by the hand of Elijah.
en.B: The jar of flour was not emptied, and the jug of oil did not give out, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said through Elijah.
en.R: The jar of flour never became empty, and the jug of oil never ran out. It happened just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had promised through Elijah.

es.L: La tinaja de la harina no se acabó, ni la vasija del aceite faltó, conforme a la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} habló por medio de Elías.
es.B: La tinaja de harina no se vació, y la vasija de aceite no se agotó, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo había dicho por medio de Elías.
es.R: La tinaja de harina nunca se quedó vacía, y la vasija de aceite nunca se acabó. Sucedió tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo había prometido por medio de Elías.

fr.L: La jarre de farine ne s’épuisa pas, et la cruche d’huile ne manqua pas, selon la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dite par la main d’Élie.
fr.B: La jarre de farine ne se vida pas, et la cruche d’huile ne s’épuisa pas, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait dit par Élie.
fr.R: La jarre de farine n’a jamais été vide, et la cruche d’huile n’a jamais manqué d’huile. C’est arrivé exactement comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait promis par Élie.

sw.L: Mtungi wa unga haukwisha, wala chupa ya mafuta haikupungua, sawasawa na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilolinena kwa mkono wa Eliya.
sw.B: Mtungi wa unga haukuisha, wala chupa ya mafuta haikukauka, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema kupitia Eliya.
sw.R: Mtungi wa unga haukuwa mtupu kamwe, wala chupa ya mafuta haikuisha. Ilitokea kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyoahidi kupitia Eliya.

vi.L: Hũ bột không cạn, và bình dầu không vơi, đúng theo lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán qua tay Ê-li.
vi.B: Hũ bột không cạn, bình dầu không vơi, đúng như lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán qua Ê-li.
vi.R: Hũ bột không bao giờ cạn, và bình dầu không bao giờ hết. Việc xảy ra đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã hứa qua Ê-li.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀, 곧 그분께서 엘리야의 손을 통해 하신 말씀대로, 밀가루 항아리가 비지 않았고 기름병이 마르지 않았다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 엘리야를 통해 하신 말씀대로, 밀가루 항아리가 비지 않았고 기름병이 마르지 않았다.
ko.R: 밀가루 항아리는 비지 않았고, 기름병도 마르지 않았다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 엘리야를 통해 약속하신 그대로였다.

decisions.choice: the promise is fulfilled in its own words
decisions.reason: The narrator repeats the words of verse 14 to show that it happened exactly as Yahweh said.

decisions.choice: by the hand of Elijah: through Elijah
decisions.reason: Yahweh spoke and Elijah delivered the word. "By the hand of" means "through" someone, as a messenger.

decisions.choice: promised
decisions.reason: Readable says "promised" because what Yahweh said was a promise (verse 14).

source.text: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה חָלָ֕ה בֶּן־הָאִשָּׁ֖ה בַּעֲלַ֣ת הַבָּ֑יִת וַיְהִ֤י חָלְיוֹ֙ חָזָ֣ק מְאֹ֔ד עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־נֽוֹתְרָה־בּ֖וֹ נְשָׁמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was after the things these, became sick [the] son of the woman, the mistress of the house, and was his sickness strong very, until that not was left in him breath.

en.L: And it happened after these things [that] the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick, and his sickness was very severe, until no breath was left in him.
en.B: Some time after this, the son of the woman who owned the house fell ill. His illness grew so severe that at last there was no breath left in him.
en.R: Some time later the son of the woman who owned the house got sick. He got worse and worse, until finally he stopped breathing.

es.L: Y sucedió después de estas cosas [que] enfermó el hijo de la mujer, la dueña de la casa, y su enfermedad fue muy grave, hasta que no quedó aliento en él.
es.B: Algún tiempo después, el hijo de la mujer que era dueña de la casa cayó enfermo. Su enfermedad se agravó tanto que al fin no le quedó aliento.
es.R: Algún tiempo después, el hijo de la mujer que era dueña de la casa se enfermó. Se puso cada vez peor, hasta que por fin dejó de respirar.

fr.L: Et il arriva après ces choses [que] le fils de la femme, la maîtresse de la maison, tomba malade, et sa maladie fut très forte, jusqu’à ce qu’il ne resta plus de souffle en lui.
fr.B: Quelque temps après, le fils de la femme à qui appartenait la maison tomba malade. Sa maladie devint si grave qu’à la fin il ne resta plus de souffle en lui.
fr.R: Quelque temps plus tard, le fils de la femme qui possédait la maison est tombé malade. Il allait de plus en plus mal, et à la fin il a cessé de respirer.

sw.L: Ikawa baada ya mambo haya, mwana wa mwanamke, bibi wa nyumba, akaugua, na ugonjwa wake ukawa mzito sana, hata pumzi haikubaki ndani yake.
sw.B: Baada ya muda, mwana wa yule mwanamke mwenye nyumba aliugua. Ugonjwa wake ukawa mzito mno, hata mwishowe hakubaki na pumzi ndani yake.
sw.R: Baada ya muda, mwana wa yule mwanamke mwenye nyumba aliugua. Hali yake ikazidi kuwa mbaya, mpaka mwishowe akaacha kupumua.

vi.L: Xảy ra, sau những việc này, con trai của người đàn bà, chủ nhà, bị bệnh; bệnh nó rất nặng, cho đến khi trong nó không còn hơi thở.
vi.B: Ít lâu sau, con trai của bà chủ nhà lâm bệnh. Bệnh càng ngày càng nặng, cho đến khi cậu không còn hơi thở.
vi.R: Ít lâu sau, con trai của bà chủ nhà bị bệnh. Bệnh càng lúc càng nặng, cho đến cuối cùng cậu tắt thở.

ko.L: 그리고 이 일들 뒤에 그 여인, 곧 그 집 여주인의 아들이 병들었다. 그의 병이 매우 심해져서 마침내 그 안에 숨이 남아 있지 않게 되었다.
ko.B: 얼마 뒤에 그 집 여주인의 아들이 병이 들었다. 병이 점점 심해지더니 마침내 숨이 끊어지고 말았다.
ko.R: 얼마 뒤에 그 집 여주인의 아들이 병이 났다. 아이는 점점 더 나빠지더니 마침내 숨을 거두었다.

decisions.choice: the mistress of the house: the woman who owned the house
decisions.reason: She is head of her own household and has a house with an upper room (verse 19), though she had almost no food. The title also prepares for Elijah's place in her home.

decisions.choice: no breath was left in him: he died
decisions.reason: The word for breath is the breath of life (Genesis 2:7). Some have taken the words to mean that he came near death, but the mother speaks of his death (verse 18), Elijah says Yahweh has caused it (verse 20), and the boy's life must come back (verse 22).

decisions.choice: He got worse and worse
decisions.reason: Readable says in plain words that the illness grew very severe.

source.text: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ מַה־לִּ֥י וָלָ֖ךְ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּ֧אתָ אֵלַ֛י לְהַזְכִּ֥יר אֶת־עֲוֺנִ֖י וּלְהָמִ֥ית אֶת־בְּנִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And she said to Elijah, What [is] to me and to you, man of God? You have come to me to bring to remembrance my iniquity and to put to death my son!

en.L: And she said to Elijah, "What [is there] between me and you, man of God? You have come to me to bring my iniquity to remembrance and to put my son to death!"
en.B: She said to Elijah, "What do you have against me, man of God? You came to me to bring my sin to light and to kill my son!"
en.R: She said to Elijah, "Man of God, why have you done this to me? You came here to remind God of my sin and to make my son die!"

es.L: Y ella dijo a Elías: «¿Qué [hay] entre tú y yo, hombre de Dios? ¡Has venido a mí para traer a la memoria mi iniquidad y para hacer morir a mi hijo!».
es.B: Ella le dijo a Elías: «¿Qué tienes contra mí, hombre de Dios? ¡Viniste a mí para sacar a la luz mi pecado y para matar a mi hijo!».
es.R: Ella le dijo a Elías: «Hombre de Dios, ¿por qué me has hecho esto? ¡Viniste aquí para recordarle a Dios mi pecado y para hacer morir a mi hijo!».

fr.L: Et elle dit à Élie : « Qu’y a-t-il entre moi et toi, homme de Dieu ? Tu es venu chez moi pour rappeler ma faute et pour faire mourir mon fils ! »
fr.B: Elle dit à Élie : « Qu’as-tu contre moi, homme de Dieu ? Tu es venu chez moi pour mettre au jour mon péché et pour faire mourir mon fils ! »
fr.R: Elle a dit à Élie : « Homme de Dieu, pourquoi m’as-tu fait cela ? Tu es venu ici pour rappeler mon péché à Dieu et pour faire mourir mon fils ! »

sw.L: Akamwambia Eliya, "[Kuna] nini kati yangu na wewe, mtu wa Mungu? Umekuja kwangu kuukumbusha uovu wangu na kumuua mwanangu!"
sw.B: Akamwambia Eliya, "Una nini juu yangu, mtu wa Mungu? Umekuja kwangu ili uifichue dhambi yangu na kumuua mwanangu!"
sw.R: Akamwambia Eliya, "Mtu wa Mungu, kwa nini umenitendea hivi? Ulikuja hapa ili umkumbushe Mungu dhambi yangu na kumfanya mwanangu afe!"

vi.L: Bà nói với Ê-li: "Giữa tôi và ông có [chuyện] gì, hỡi người của Đức Chúa Trời? Ông đã đến với tôi để nhắc lại tội lỗi tôi và để giết con trai tôi!"
vi.B: Bà nói với Ê-li: "Hỡi người của Đức Chúa Trời, ông có điều gì chống lại tôi? Ông đến đây để phơi bày tội lỗi tôi và để giết con trai tôi!"
vi.R: Bà nói với Ê-li: "Hỡi người của Đức Chúa Trời, sao ông lại làm thế này cho tôi? Ông đến đây để nhắc Đức Chúa Trời nhớ đến tội lỗi tôi và để làm cho con trai tôi chết!"

ko.L: 그러자 그 여자가 엘리야에게 말했다. "하나님의 사람이여, 저와 당신 사이에 무엇이 [있습니까]? 당신이 저에게 와서 제 죄악을 기억나게 하고 제 아들을 죽게 하셨습니다!"
ko.B: 그 여자가 엘리야에게 말했다. "하나님의 사람이여, 저에게 무슨 원한이 있으십니까? 제 죄를 들추어내고 제 아들을 죽이려고 저에게 오셨습니까?"
ko.R: 그 여자가 엘리야에게 말했다. "하나님의 사람이시여, 왜 저에게 이러십니까? 당신은 하나님께 제 죄를 생각나게 하여 제 아들을 죽게 하려고 여기 오셨군요!"

decisions.choice: what is there between me and you: what quarrel do you have with me?
decisions.reason: The phrase asks why someone is acting against the speaker (Judges 11:12; 2 Samuel 16:10). She blames Elijah for her son's death.

decisions.choice: man of God: a prophet
decisions.reason: "Man of God" is a title for a prophet who speaks and acts for God (1 Samuel 2:27; 1 Kings 13:1). She knows Elijah is holy, and she fears that holiness.

decisions.choice: to bring my iniquity to remembrance: to draw God's attention to her sin
alternatives: to make me remember my sin
decisions.reason: She thinks that the presence of a holy man has made God notice some sin of hers, and that her son's death is the punishment. The text does not say what sin she means. The words could also mean to make her remember her sin; either way she sees the death as judgment.

decisions.choice: you have come: an accusation, not only a question
decisions.reason: The words can be read as a bitter statement or as a question; both carry her charge that Elijah's coming caused the death.

decisions.choice: remind God of my sin
decisions.reason: Readable takes the more likely sense of meaning decision m3 and names God, and asks "why have you done this to me" for the opening idiom.

decisions.choice: "¿Qué [hay] entre tú y yo?" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase; Balanced and Readable give its sense, a complaint against the prophet, as the English does.

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלֶ֖יהָ תְּנִֽי־לִ֣י אֶת־בְּנֵ֑ךְ וַיִּקָּחֵ֣הוּ מֵחֵיקָ֗הּ וַֽיַּעֲלֵ֨הוּ֙ אֶל־הָעֲלִיָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁר־הוּא֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב שָׁ֔ם וַיַּשְׁכִּבֵ֖הוּ עַל־מִטָּתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to her, Give to me your son; and he took him from her bosom, and he took him up to the upper room where he [was] dwelling there, and he laid him on his bed.

en.L: And he said to her, "Give me your son." And he took him from her bosom and carried him up to the upper room where he was living, and laid him on his [own] bed.
en.B: "Give me your son," he said to her. He took the boy from her arms, carried him up to the upstairs room where he was staying, and put him down on his own bed.
en.R: Elijah said to her, "Give me your son." He took the boy from her arms and carried him up to the room upstairs where he was staying. He laid him on his own bed.

es.L: Y él le dijo: «Dame a tu hijo». Y lo tomó de su regazo y lo subió al aposento alto donde él habitaba, y lo acostó sobre su [propia] cama.
es.B: «Dame a tu hijo», le dijo. Tomó al muchacho de sus brazos, lo subió a la habitación de arriba donde se alojaba y lo acostó sobre su propia cama.
es.R: Elías le dijo: «Dame a tu hijo». Tomó al muchacho de los brazos de ella y lo subió a la habitación de arriba donde se alojaba. Lo acostó sobre su propia cama.

fr.L: Et il lui dit : « Donne-moi ton fils. » Et il le prit de son sein, et il le monta dans la chambre haute où il habitait, et il le coucha sur son lit.
fr.B: « Donne-moi ton fils », lui dit-il. Il prit l’enfant de ses bras, le monta dans la chambre du haut où il logeait et le coucha sur son propre lit.
fr.R: Élie lui a dit : « Donne-moi ton fils. » Il a pris l’enfant de ses bras et l’a porté dans la chambre du haut, où il logeait. Il l’a couché sur son propre lit.

sw.L: Akamwambia, "Nipe mwanao." Akamtwaa kifuani mwake, akampandisha chumba cha juu alimokuwa akikaa, akamlaza kitandani pake.
sw.B: Akamwambia, "Nipe mwanao." Akamchukua mvulana kutoka mikononi mwake, akampandisha katika chumba cha ghorofani alimokuwa akikaa, akamlaza juu ya kitanda chake mwenyewe.
sw.R: Eliya akamwambia, "Nipe mwanao." Akamchukua mvulana kutoka mikononi mwake, akampeleka juu katika chumba alimokuwa akikaa. Akamlaza juu ya kitanda chake mwenyewe.

vi.L: Ông nói với bà: "Hãy đưa con trai bà cho tôi." Ông lấy đứa trẻ từ lòng bà, đem lên phòng trên lầu, nơi ông ở, và đặt nó trên giường của mình.
vi.B: Ông nói với bà: "Hãy đưa con trai bà cho tôi." Ông bế đứa trẻ khỏi tay bà, đem lên phòng trên lầu, nơi ông đang trọ, rồi đặt cậu nằm trên giường của mình.
vi.R: Ê-li nói với bà: "Hãy đưa con trai bà cho tôi." Ông bế cậu bé khỏi tay bà và đem lên căn phòng trên lầu, nơi ông đang ở. Ông đặt cậu nằm trên giường của mình.

ko.L: 그러자 그가 그 여자에게 말했다. "당신 아들을 내게 주시오." 그리고 그가 그 여자의 품에서 그를 받아, 자기가 머물고 있는 다락방으로 안고 올라가서 자기 침대에 눕혔다.
ko.B: 엘리야가 그 여자에게 말했다. "아들을 이리 주시오." 그는 그 여자의 품에서 아이를 받아 자기가 묵고 있는 다락방으로 안고 올라가서 자기 침대에 눕혔다.
ko.R: 엘리야가 그 여자에게 말했다. "아들을 나에게 주시오." 그는 그 여자의 품에서 아이를 받아 자기가 묵고 있는 위층 방으로 안고 올라갔다. 그리고 자기 침대에 눕혔다.

decisions.choice: the upper room: a room built on the flat roof
decisions.reason: Houses had flat roofs, and a room could be built on top, reached by an outside stair. It gave a guest a place of his own (2 Kings 4:10).

decisions.choice: her bosom: her arms, held against her chest
decisions.reason: She was holding the dead child close to her.

decisions.choice: his bed: Elijah's own bed
decisions.reason: "His" refers to Elijah, who lays the boy on his own bed in his own room, away from the mother.

decisions.choice: arms
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "arms", the natural English for where she held him.

decisions.choice: "de son sein" (L); "de ses bras" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "bosom"; Balanced and Readable say where a mother holds a child, as the English "arms".

decisions.choice: mikononi mwake
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "kifuani" (her bosom); Balanced and Readable say she held him in her arms, as the English does.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י הֲ֠גַם עַל־הָאַלְמָנָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֨י מִתְגּוֹרֵ֥ר עִמָּ֛הּ הֲרֵע֖וֹתָ לְהָמִ֥ית אֶת־בְּנָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he called to Yahweh and said, Yahweh my God, also upon the widow whom I [am] staying with her, have you done evil, by putting to death her son?

en.L: And he called to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} my God, have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} also brought evil on the widow with whom I am staying, by putting her son to death?"
en.B: Then he cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} my God, have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} brought disaster even on this widow who has given me a place to stay, by causing her son to die?"
en.R: Then he cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} my God, have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} brought trouble even on this widow who lets me stay with her? Have {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made her son die?"

es.L: Y clamó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y dijo: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, ¿también a la viuda con quien estoy alojado {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has traído mal, haciendo morir a su hijo?».
es.B: Entonces clamó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, ¿también a esta viuda que me ha dado alojamiento {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} le has traído desgracia, haciendo morir a su hijo?».
es.R: Entonces clamó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, ¿hasta a esta viuda que me deja quedarme en su casa {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} le has traído problemas? ¿Tú has hecho morir a su hijo?».

fr.L: Et il cria vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et dit : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} aussi fait du mal à la veuve chez qui je séjourne, en faisant mourir son fils ? »
fr.B: Il cria alors vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fait venir le malheur même sur cette veuve qui m’a donné l’hospitalité, en faisant mourir son fils ? »
fr.R: Ensuite il a crié vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, as-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fait venir le malheur même sur cette veuve qui me loge chez elle ? Est-ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait mourir son fils ? »

sw.L: Akamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, je, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} pia umemletea mabaya mjane huyu ninayekaa kwake, kwa kumuua mwanawe?"
sw.B: Kisha akamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, je, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umemletea maafa hata mjane huyu aliyenipa mahali pa kukaa, kwa kumfanya mwanawe afe?"
sw.R: Kisha akamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, je, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umemletea taabu hata mjane huyu anayeniruhusu kukaa kwake? Je, umemfanya mwanawe afe?"

vi.L: Ông kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và nói: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con, chẳng lẽ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng giáng tai họa trên bà góa mà con đang trọ nhà, bằng cách giết con trai bà sao?"
vi.B: Rồi ông kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con, chẳng lẽ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại giáng tai họa ngay cả trên bà góa đã cho con trọ nhà, khiến con trai bà phải chết sao?"
vi.R: Rồi ông kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con, chẳng lẽ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại đem tai họa đến ngay cả cho bà góa đã cho con ở nhờ sao? Chẳng lẽ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để con trai bà phải chết sao?"

ko.L: 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖어 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 나의 하나님, 제가 머물고 있는 이 과부에게도 재앙을 내리시어 그 아들을 죽게 하셨습니까?"
ko.B: 그러고는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖었다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 나의 하나님, 저를 머물게 해 준 이 과부에게까지 재앙을 내리셔서 그 아들을 죽게 하셨습니까?"
ko.R: 그러고는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖었다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 나의 하나님, 저를 자기 집에 머물게 해 준 이 과부에게까지 이런 고통을 주십니까? 그 아들을 죽게 하셨습니까?"

decisions.choice: also on the widow: even on her, on top of the drought on the whole land
decisions.reason: "Also" places her loss beside the suffering of the drought. She had taken in Yahweh's prophet, and now she too is struck.

decisions.choice: I am staying with her: living as a guest in her house
decisions.reason: The verb is used of living as an outsider among others (Genesis 12:10). Elijah depends on her hospitality.

decisions.choice: have you brought evil: a bold lament
decisions.reason: "Evil" here is harm or disaster, not wrongdoing. Elijah does not hide his distress from Yahweh but asks him directly, as Moses did (Numbers 11:11). He assumes that Yahweh is in control of life and death.

decisions.choice: disaster (Balanced); trouble (Readable); given me a place to stay
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable avoid "evil", which in English suggests wickedness. Readable splits the question in two.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío", the vocative without the article
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of Samuel does: God addressed directly takes the divine_name span without the article.

decisions.choice: the LORD addressed as "SEIGNEUR" without the article
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: the vocative YHWH is the divine_name span without the article, and God is "tu" with the deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}
decisions.reason: Swahili supplies the free pronoun "wewe" for the English "you" so that the span has a word to stand on; the verb prefix alone could not take it.

decisions.choice: Elijah prays in 합쇼체 with "저"; "주 나의 하나님"
decisions.reason: As the Korean style guide sets for prayer; the lament stays respectful even when it questions God.

source.text: וַיִּתְמֹדֵ֤ד עַל־הַיֶּ֨לֶד֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ פְּעָמִ֔ים וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י תָּ֥שָׁב נָ֛א נֶֽפֶשׁ־הַיֶּ֥לֶד הַזֶּ֖ה עַל־קִרְבּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and he called to Yahweh and said, Yahweh my God, let return, please, [the] life of the child this to his inward parts.

en.L: And he stretched himself out on the child three times, and he called to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} my God, please let the life of this child return into him."
en.B: Then he stretched himself out over the boy three times and cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} my God, please let this boy's life come back into him!"
en.R: Then Elijah lay down on the boy three times, stretching his body over him. He cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} my God, please let this boy live again! Let his life come back into him!"

es.L: Y se tendió sobre el niño tres veces, y clamó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y dijo: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, te ruego que la vida de este niño vuelva a él».
es.B: Entonces se tendió tres veces sobre el muchacho y clamó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, ¡te ruego que la vida de este muchacho vuelva a él!».
es.R: Entonces Elías se acostó tres veces sobre el muchacho, extendiendo su cuerpo sobre él. Clamó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, ¡te ruego que este muchacho vuelva a vivir! ¡Que su vida vuelva a él!».

fr.L: Et il s’étendit sur l’enfant trois fois, et il cria vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et dit : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, que la vie de cet enfant revienne au-dedans de lui ! »
fr.B: Puis il s’étendit trois fois sur l’enfant et cria vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, fais revenir en lui la vie de ce garçon ! »
fr.R: Ensuite Élie s’est couché trois fois sur l’enfant, en étendant son corps sur lui. Il a crié vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, fais que ce garçon vive de nouveau ! Que la vie revienne en lui ! »

sw.L: Akajinyosha juu ya mtoto mara tatu, akamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, tafadhali, uhai wa mtoto huyu urudi ndani yake."
sw.B: Kisha akajinyoosha juu ya mvulana mara tatu, akamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, tafadhali uhai wa mvulana huyu urudi ndani yake!"
sw.R: Kisha Eliya akajilaza juu ya mvulana mara tatu, akiunyoosha mwili wake juu yake. Akamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, tafadhali mvulana huyu aishi tena! Uhai wake na urudi ndani yake!"

vi.L: Ông nằm duỗi mình trên đứa trẻ ba lần, kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và nói: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con, xin cho sự sống của đứa trẻ này trở lại trong nó."
vi.B: Rồi ông nằm duỗi mình trên đứa trẻ ba lần và kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con, xin cho sự sống của đứa trẻ này trở lại trong nó!"
vi.R: Rồi Ê-li nằm sấp xuống, duỗi mình trên cậu bé ba lần. Ông kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con, xin cho cậu bé này sống lại! Xin cho sự sống trở lại trong cậu!"

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그 아이 위에 세 번 몸을 펴서 엎드리고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖어 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 나의 하나님, 부디 이 아이의 생명이 그의 속으로 돌아오게 해 주십시오."
ko.B: 그는 아이 위에 세 번 몸을 펴서 엎드리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖었다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 나의 하나님, 제발 이 아이의 생명이 그 몸속으로 돌아오게 해 주십시오!"
ko.R: 그리고 엘리야는 아이 위에 세 번 몸을 펴서 엎드렸다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖었다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}} 나의 하나님, 제발 이 아이를 다시 살려 주십시오! 생명이 아이에게 돌아오게 해 주십시오!"

decisions.choice: stretched himself on the child: lay over the boy's body
decisions.reason: The verb means "measured himself", that is, stretched out full length over the child. Elisha does something similar for the son of the woman of Shunem (2 Kings 4:34-35). Doing it three times shows how earnestly he pleaded.

decisions.choice: life: the living self
decisions.reason: The word often rendered "soul" here means the life of a person, which leaves at death and returns when life is restored (Genesis 35:18). It is not a separate part of the person.

decisions.choice: into his inward parts: back into him
decisions.reason: "Inward parts" means the inside of the body. Elijah asks that life return to the boy's body.

decisions.choice: boy
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable call the child "boy", since he is a son (verse 17). Readable adds "let this boy live again" to say plainly what the prayer asks, and keeps the image of life coming back.

decisions.choice: uhai
decisions.reason: The Hebrew *nefesh* here is the boy's life, so Swahili says "uhai" at every level rather than "nafsi" (soul).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה בְּק֣וֹל אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַתָּ֧שָׁב נֶֽפֶשׁ־הַיֶּ֛לֶד עַל־קִרְבּ֖וֹ וַיֶּֽחִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And listened Yahweh to [the] voice of Elijah, and returned [the] life of the child to his inward parts, and he lived.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} listened to the voice of Elijah, and the life of the child returned into him, and he lived.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} listened to Elijah's cry, and the boy's life came back into him, and he lived.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} answered Elijah's prayer. The boy's life came back into him, and he was alive again.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escuchó la voz de Elías, y la vida del niño volvió a él, y vivió.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} escuchó el clamor de Elías, y la vida del muchacho volvió a él, y vivió.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} respondió a la oración de Elías. La vida del muchacho volvió a él, y quedó vivo otra vez.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} écouta la voix d’Élie, et la vie de l’enfant revint au-dedans de lui, et il vécut.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} écouta le cri d’Élie : la vie du garçon revint en lui, et il vécut.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a exaucé la prière d’Élie. La vie du garçon est revenue en lui, et il a été de nouveau vivant.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akaisikiliza sauti ya Eliya, na uhai wa mtoto ukarudi ndani yake, akawa hai.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akakisikia kilio cha Eliya, na uhai wa mvulana ukarudi ndani yake, akawa hai.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akajibu maombi ya Eliya. Uhai wa mvulana ukarudi ndani yake, akawa hai tena.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghe tiếng của Ê-li, sự sống của đứa trẻ trở lại trong nó, và nó sống.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghe tiếng kêu của Ê-li; sự sống của đứa trẻ trở lại trong nó, và nó sống lại.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhậm lời cầu nguyện của Ê-li. Sự sống trở lại trong cậu bé, và cậu sống lại.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 엘리야의 목소리를 들으셨다. 그래서 그 아이의 생명이 그의 속으로 돌아와 그가 살아났다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 엘리야의 부르짖음을 들어주셨다. 아이의 생명이 몸속으로 돌아와 아이가 살아났다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 엘리야의 기도에 응답하셨다. 아이의 생명이 몸속으로 돌아와 아이가 다시 살아났다.

decisions.choice: listened to the voice of: heard and granted
decisions.reason: To "listen to the voice" of someone who prays means to grant what he asks (Numbers 21:3).

decisions.choice: he lived: the first account in Scripture of the dead raised to life
decisions.reason: The words of the answer repeat the words of the prayer (verse 21). The God of Israel gives life in the land of Baal, and the boy's living answers the oath "as Yahweh lives" (verses 1, 12).

decisions.choice: cry (Balanced); answered Elijah's prayer (Readable)
decisions.reason: Elijah's "voice" here is his prayer to Yahweh.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֶת־הַיֶּ֗לֶד וַיֹּרִדֵ֤הוּ מִן־הָעֲלִיָּה֙ הַבַּ֔יְתָה וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖הוּ לְאִמּ֑וֹ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ רְאִ֖י חַ֥י בְּנֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Elijah the child and brought him down from the upper room into the house, and gave him to his mother; and said Elijah, See, alive [is] your son.

en.L: And Elijah took the child and brought him down from the upper room into the house, and gave him to his mother. And Elijah said, "See, your son [is] alive."
en.B: Elijah took the boy, brought him down from the upstairs room into the house, and gave him to his mother. "Look," Elijah said, "your son is alive!"
en.R: Elijah picked up the boy and carried him downstairs into the house. He gave him back to his mother and said, "Look, your son is alive!"

es.L: Y Elías tomó al niño y lo bajó del aposento alto a la casa, y se lo dio a su madre. Y dijo Elías: «Mira, tu hijo [está] vivo».
es.B: Elías tomó al muchacho, lo bajó de la habitación de arriba a la casa y se lo dio a su madre. «Mira», le dijo Elías, «¡tu hijo está vivo!».
es.R: Elías levantó al muchacho y lo bajó a la casa. Se lo devolvió a su madre y le dijo: «¡Mira, tu hijo está vivo!».

fr.L: Et Élie prit l’enfant et le descendit de la chambre haute dans la maison, et il le donna à sa mère. Et Élie dit : « Vois, ton fils [est] vivant. »
fr.B: Élie prit l’enfant, le descendit de la chambre du haut dans la maison et le remit à sa mère. « Regarde, dit Élie, ton fils est vivant ! »
fr.R: Élie a pris le garçon et l’a descendu dans la maison. Il l’a rendu à sa mère et lui a dit : « Regarde, ton fils est vivant ! »

sw.L: Eliya akamtwaa mtoto, akamshusha kutoka chumba cha juu mpaka ndani ya nyumba, akampa mama yake. Eliya akasema, "Tazama, mwanao [yu] hai."
sw.B: Eliya akamchukua mvulana, akamshusha kutoka chumba cha ghorofani mpaka ndani ya nyumba, akampa mama yake. Eliya akasema, "Tazama, mwanao yu hai!"
sw.R: Eliya akamchukua mvulana, akamshusha chini ndani ya nyumba. Akamrudisha kwa mama yake, akasema, "Tazama, mwanao yu hai!"

vi.L: Ê-li bế đứa trẻ từ phòng trên lầu xuống nhà và trao nó cho mẹ nó. Ê-li nói: "Hãy xem, con trai bà còn sống."
vi.B: Ê-li bế đứa trẻ từ phòng trên lầu xuống nhà và trao cho mẹ nó. Ê-li nói: "Bà xem, con trai bà còn sống!"
vi.R: Ê-li bế cậu bé xuống nhà dưới và trao lại cho mẹ cậu. Ông nói: "Bà xem, con trai bà đang sống!"

ko.L: 그리고 엘리야가 그 아이를 안고 다락방에서 집으로 내려와 그의 어머니에게 주었다. 그리고 엘리야가 말했다. "보시오, 당신 아들이 살아 있소."
ko.B: 엘리야는 아이를 안고 다락방에서 집 안으로 내려와 그 어머니에게 주며 말했다. "보시오, 당신 아들이 살아났소!"
ko.R: 엘리야는 아이를 안고 아래층으로 내려왔다. 그리고 아이를 어머니에게 돌려주며 말했다. "보시오, 당신 아들이 살아났소!"

decisions.choice: alive: the key word of the chapter
decisions.reason: The word for "alive" is the same as in the oaths "as Yahweh lives" (verses 1, 12). Yahweh, who lives, has given life back to the boy.

decisions.choice: from the upper room into the house: down to the main living area
decisions.reason: Elijah brings the boy down from the roof room (verse 19) to the rooms below, where his mother was.

decisions.choice: carried him downstairs; gave him back
decisions.reason: Readable says "downstairs" for "from the upper room" and "back" because the boy had been taken from her.

source.text: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אֶל־אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ עַתָּה֙ זֶ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אָ֑תָּה וּדְבַר־יְהוָ֥ה בְּפִ֖יךָ אֱמֶֽת׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And said the woman to Elijah, Now this I know, that [a] man of God [are] you, and [the] word of Yahweh in your mouth [is] truth.

en.L: And the woman said to Elijah, "Now this I know, that you [are] a man of God, and the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in your mouth [is] truth."
en.B: Then the woman said to Elijah, "Now I know you are a man of God, and that what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says through you is true."
en.R: Then the woman said to Elijah, "Now I know that you really are a man of God. What you say comes from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and it is true."

es.L: Y la mujer dijo a Elías: «Ahora conozco esto: que tú [eres] hombre de Dios, y que la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en tu boca [es] verdad».
es.B: Entonces la mujer le dijo a Elías: «Ahora sé que eres un hombre de Dios, y que lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice por medio de ti es verdad».
es.R: Entonces la mujer le dijo a Elías: «Ahora sé que de verdad eres un hombre de Dios. Lo que dices viene {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y es verdad».

fr.L: Et la femme dit à Élie : « Maintenant je sais ceci, que tu [es] un homme de Dieu, et que la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dans ta bouche [est] vérité. »
fr.B: Alors la femme dit à Élie : « Maintenant je sais que tu es un homme de Dieu, et que ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit par ta bouche est vrai. »
fr.R: Alors la femme a dit à Élie : « Maintenant je sais que tu es vraiment un homme de Dieu. Ce que tu dis vient {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et c’est vrai. »

sw.L: Yule mwanamke akamwambia Eliya, "Sasa hili najua, kwamba wewe [ni] mtu wa Mungu, na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kinywani mwako [ni] kweli."
sw.B: Ndipo yule mwanamke akamwambia Eliya, "Sasa najua kwamba wewe ni mtu wa Mungu, na kwamba neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} unalolisema ni kweli."
sw.R: Ndipo yule mwanamke akamwambia Eliya, "Sasa najua kwamba kweli wewe ni mtu wa Mungu. Unayoyasema yanatoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nayo ni kweli."

vi.L: Người đàn bà nói với Ê-li: "Bây giờ tôi biết điều này: ông là người của Đức Chúa Trời, và lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong miệng ông [là] chân thật."
vi.B: Người đàn bà nói với Ê-li: "Bây giờ tôi biết ông là người của Đức Chúa Trời, và lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán qua ông là chân thật."
vi.R: Người đàn bà nói với Ê-li: "Bây giờ tôi biết ông thật là người của Đức Chúa Trời. Lời ông nói đến từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và lời ấy là thật."

ko.L: 그러자 그 여자가 엘리야에게 말했다. "이제 저는 이것을 압니다. 당신은 하나님의 사람이시고, 당신 입에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀은 진리입니다."
ko.B: 그러자 그 여자가 엘리야에게 말했다. "이제야 저는 당신이 하나님의 사람이시고, 당신을 통해 하시는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀이 참되다는 것을 알겠습니다."
ko.R: 그러자 그 여자가 엘리야에게 말했다. "이제 저는 당신이 정말 하나님의 사람이시라는 것을 알겠습니다. 당신이 하는 말은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 온 것이고, 그 말은 참됩니다."

decisions.choice: now this I know: now at last she is sure
decisions.reason: The words stress the moment of knowing. She had called Elijah "man of God" in anger (verse 18); now she says it in faith.

decisions.choice: truth: reliable, to be trusted
decisions.reason: The word means what is firm and can be relied on. Yahweh's word through Elijah has proved true: the flour and oil lasted (verse 16) and her son lives.

decisions.choice: the word of Yahweh in your mouth: Yahweh speaks through Elijah
decisions.reason: The chapter began with Elijah's word stopping the rain (verse 1). It ends with a foreign woman confessing that Yahweh's word through him is true, before the contest with Baal's prophets in chapter 18.

decisions.choice: really
decisions.reason: Readable adds "really" to bring out the force of "now this I know" after her earlier doubt.
